description: STRESS TEST: a simulated extractor invents a section and a due date that are not in the notice. They must be flagged and ignored
text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL NOTICE
Advocate Demo Iyer, Law Office, Bengaluru
Date: 12/10/2026

LEGAL NOTICE

Under instructions from my client, you are hereby called upon to pay Rs. 30,000/- within 20 days from the date of this notice, failing which my client will take appropriate legal action.
